_comment: RED baseline (RLOO variant): the parent project's canonical RL protocol (corrected_rl_launcher.common_config) with RED's reward redistribution and RLOO's leave-one-out advantage. Every training parameter is copied from formal250.json so this arm is comparable with GRPO, VPO-RM and P2T; only the credit assignment differs. init_adapter must be set to the SFT checkpoint before this runs; sigma0 must be shared with the sibling arms, do not let this arm self-calibrate. Paper-specific notes: (1) beta_c is RED Eq. (7)'s convex-combination weight, 1.0 removes the sparse sequence term entirely; (2) the KL coefficient rides in 'beta' and is applied INSIDE the reward per Eq. (8), so the trainer applies no separate KL loss term; (3) clip_eps and advantage_std_floor_fraction are carried for config parity but are NOT read by a RED update -- RLOO has no importance ratio to clip and does not standardise the advantage. The run manifest stamps red_clipping and red_advantage_rule so this is never ambiguous after the fact. push_every is 0: enabling it needs the branch/remote decision recorded in RED_REPRO_NOTES.md 8.
